message: 1 consumer group(s) have a diet composition (including diet_import) that does not sum to 1 (tol=0.001): 18 (Albacore)=1.0010.

Diet normalization compensated through runtime biomass accumulation for 7 Regular/PP group(s); computational closure, not observed biomass change. EE, M0 and detritus flows retained; see diet_normalization_balance_ledger.
1 group(s) have TE=0 because EE=0 (M0=p): 4 (Toothed whales). Their consumed PP is re-credited to detritus (fix_EE_0_cases=True) so the TE SPPR stays PP-balanced.

4 group(s) have near-zero TE (0 < EE << 1): 6 (Mesopelagic dolphins), 5 (Spotted dolphin), 2 (Grazing birds), 1 (Pursuit birds). Their SPPR is near-singular (inherent to the TE method); the detritus SPPR may be inflated and is not corrected by fix_EE_0_cases.
